rules.instruction: MUST preserve attachment contents if a later read, load, resolve, sample or readback needs them, or liveness is unknown. Invalidate only proven-dead contents; measure performance separately.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Framebuffer invalidation: invalidated contents become undefined.

rules.instruction: Delete only with a live compatible current context for that object and generation; queue cleanup if temporarily unavailable, and drop stale names after context loss. Do not assume context-local objects are shareable.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Current contexts, object sharing and context loss.

rules.instruction: Fragment floating-point declarations MUST have valid default or explicit precision. Select mediump or highp from required range, error bounds and target support; no universal mediump default.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Precision qualifiers and default precision in fragment shaders.

rules.instruction: Do not upload pixels into GL_TEXTURE_EXTERNAL_OES with glTexImage2D. If CPU access to the source is permitted, copying into a normal GL_TEXTURE_2D with valid format/stride is a separate legal fallback.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Texture image specification and pixel storage.

rules.instruction: Use a format-, sample- and region-valid core blit resolve as the baseline when available. Compare on-target extension alternatives only when the exact extension, entry point and configuration are supported.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Extension-specific entry points and resolve semantics.

rules.instruction: Depth pre-pass is a measured experiment, not a vendor mandate or ban. Keep single-pass when benefit or correctness is unproven; test depth equality, ordering, overdraw and geometry cost on the target.
rules.scope: GLES 3.x unless named extension or EGL applies

primary_sources.clause: Depth test and per-fragment operations; performance advice is policy, not a specification requirement.
